pages.title: Harness size guide
pages.body: Measure the widest part of your dog's chest, just behind the front legs.

articles.title: How to choose a dog harness
articles.body: Front-clip harnesses reduce pulling; back-clip harnesses suit calm walkers. Measure the chest girth before you buy.

articles.title: Dog leash length guide: 4 ft, 6 ft or long line?
articles.body: A 6 ft leash is the standard for city walking. Long lines are for recall training in open spaces.

articles.title: Orthopedic dog beds explained
articles.body: Memory foam supports older dogs' joints. Look for at least 3 inches of foam.

products.title: Front-Clip No-Pull Harness
products.descriptionHtml: Leash ring on the chest turns the dog sideways when it pulls. Four adjustment points. Padded neoprene chest plate. Reflective stitching. Sizes XS to XL, chest girth 13–42 in.

products.title: Biothane Leash, 6 ft
products.descriptionHtml: Coated webbing that does not absorb water or smell. 6 ft long, 5/8 in wide. Brass snap hook. Wipe clean. Breaking strength 600 lb.

products.title: Training Long Line, 30 ft
products.descriptionHtml: 30 ft of lightweight biothane for recall practice. No handle loop, so it does not snag. Floats in water. Stainless steel swivel clip.

products.title: Memory Foam Dog Bed
products.descriptionHtml: 4 in of memory foam on a 1 in support base. Removable cover, machine washable at 40 °C. Water-resistant liner. Non-slip bottom. Sizes M (30 × 20 in) and L (40 × 28 in).

products.title: Fleece Dog Blanket
products.descriptionHtml: Double-layer polar fleece, 40 × 30 in. Machine washable, tumble dry low. Fits in the car boot or on the sofa.

products.title: Rechargeable LED Collar Light
products.descriptionHtml: Clips onto any collar or harness. Three modes: steady, slow flash, fast flash. Visible from about 1,000 ft. USB-C charging, 6 hours on steady. Rated IPX7 waterproof.
